definitions.explanation: A hand with the fingers closed tightly into the palm.

examples.japanese: {拳|こぶし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}りしめた→握りしめる：04241_nigirishimeru⟧。
{拳|こぶし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叩|たた}いた→叩く：02072_tataku⟧。
examples.english: I pounded the table with my fist.

examples.japanese: {拳|こぶし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}り→振る：01983_furu⟧⟦{上|あ}げて→上げる：00546_ageru⟧⟦{抗議|こうぎ}→抗議：12807_kougi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I raised my fist in protest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{悔|くや}しくて→悔しい：02343_kuyashii⟧、{拳|こぶし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ぎゅっと→ぎゅっと：05355_gyutto⟧⟦{握|にぎ}った→握る：02383_nigiru⟧。
examples.english: Frustrated, I clenched my fist tightly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|か}って→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧、⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦たち→たち：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{拳|こぶし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突|つ}き→突く：12735_tsuku⟧⟦{上|あ}げて→上げる：00546_ageru⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}んだ→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: Having won the match, the players thrust their fists in the air and celebrated.

notes:
{拳|こぶし} refers to the fist - a hand with fingers closed tightly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {拳|こぶし}を⟦{握|にぎ}る→握る：02383_nigiru⟧: to clench one's fist
- {拳|こぶし}を⟦{握|にぎ}りしめる→握りしめる：04241_nigirishimeru⟧: to clench one's fist tightly
- {拳|こぶし}を⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧: to swing one's fist
- {拳|こぶし}を⟦{振|ふ}り→振る：01983_furu⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：00546_ageru⟧: to raise one's fist
- {拳|こぶし}を⟦{突|つ}き→突く：12735_tsuku⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：00546_ageru⟧: to thrust one's fist up

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{握|にぎ}りこぶし→握りこぶし：29030_nigirikobushi⟧: clenched fist
- ⟦{鉄拳|てっけん}→鉄拳：noentry⟧: iron fist
- ⟦{拳法|けんぽう}→拳法：23872_kenpou⟧: martial arts (Chinese boxing)
- ⟦{拳銃|けんじゅう}→拳銃：16266_kenjuu⟧: pistol (lit. fist-gun)

IDIOM:
{拳|こぶし}で⟦{語|かた}る→語る：01930_kataru⟧: to speak with fists (resort to violence)
